stature.basis: Heritage: a French-Canadian father and a French and Potawatomi mother (Wau-Bun calls her a half-breed wife). No description of any child. Heights in figures[] from Height for age: the CDC 2000 stature-for-age table at the 5th centile for the age on 14 Aug 1812. Not a measurement. Why that centile: Steckel 1985 finds slave children below the first centile of modern standards and Komlos 2003 puts American apprentices of 14 at the 0.8th, while American adults reached about the 20th-30th; free children of a fed frontier household are set at the 5th.
